mapper.sql: id, shop_code, detailcode, ordercode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, shippedqty, remainingqty, custom_made, sourcecode, price, amount, costprice, costamount, remark
mapper.select:
select d.detailcode, d.lineno, d.goodscode, d.goodsname, d.spec, d.unit, d.qty, d.shippedqty, d.custom_made, d.sourcecode, greatest(d.qty - coalesce(d.shippedqty, 0), 0) as pending_qty, o.ordercode, o.orderstate, o.createtime, o.buyershop from sdsorder.u_o_orderdetail_${tableSuffix} d join sdsorder.u_o_order_${tableSuffix} o on o.shop_code = d.shop_code and o.ordercode = d.ordercode where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and o.orderstate in ('已备货', '备货中', '发货中') and d.qty - coalesce(d.shippedqty, 0) > 0
and d.goodscode = #{goodsCode} order by o.createtime desc, d.ordercode, d.lineno
mapper.insert:
insert into sdsorder.u_o_orderdetail_${tableSuffix} (shop_code, detailcode, ordercode, lineno, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, shippedqty, remainingqty, custom_made, sourcecode, price, amount, costprice, costamount, remark) values
(#{item.shopCode}, #{item.detailCode}, #{item.orderCode}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.qty}, 0, #{item.qty}, coalesce(#{item.customMade}, 0), #{item.sourceCode}, #{item.price}, #{item.amount}, coalesce(#{item.costPrice}, 0), coalesce(#{item.costAmount}, 0), #{item.remark})
mapper.delete: delete from sdsorder.u_o_orderdetail_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and ordercode = #{orderCode}
